deletion_test.reason: phase6_settings_panel.py already owns Settings presentation. The six bridge functions form compatibility/dataflow projection glue over existing domain owners and bridge-host state. Moving them to the panel would make presentation own domain projection semantics; extracting a second helper would primarily forward the same callbacks/state or duplicate existing BoxBody/FW/WRAP/Corner rules. The approved no-shallow-wrapper rule therefore selects KEEP_BRIDGE_COMPATIBILITY.
deletion_test.deepening_settings_panel_rejected: Would move read-only domain projection assembly into the presentation owner and blur the explicit callback-only state-mutation boundary.
deletion_test.pure_projection_extraction_rejected: The exact-six set is not a cohesive pure-value algorithm: it reads bridge/workspace/domain state and synchronizes legacy compatibility handles. A new module would be a forwarding/service-bag wrapper unless domain contracts were redesigned beyond T4 scope.
